Jaimin Umaraniya is a Senior Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer based in
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He has 5+ years of professional experience designing
and building modern, high-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, and
AI-powered digital products.

He specializes in the React ecosystem (React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript) and
Firebase backend architecture, with deep expertise in AI integration using the
Google Gemini API, OpenRouter, and LLM-based content workflows.

Jaimin's work is characterized by three core qualities:

Industries served: SaaS, edtech, developer tools, personal branding, AI
products, e-commerce, content platforms, and technical consulting.

# SECTION 4: TECHNOLOGIES (DETAILED)
================================================================================

React — A JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Jaimin uses React 19
  with functional components, hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo,
  useRef, useContext), and Suspense for async rendering. He is proficient with
  concurrent mode features like useTransition and useDeferredValue.

Next.js — React framework by Vercel enabling SSR, SSG, ISR, and App Router
  with Server Components. Jaimin uses Next.js for SEO-critical applications
  requiring pre-rendered HTML delivered to both users and crawlers.

TypeScript — Statically typed superset of JavaScript. Jaimin uses TypeScript
  in strict mode across all projects, employing generics, discriminated unions,
  template literal types, and utility types for type-safe codebases.

Firebase — Google's application development platform. Jaimin uses Firestore
  for real-time NoSQL database, Firebase Auth for user management, Firebase
  Storage for media, and Cloud Functions for serverless compute.

Tailwind CSS v4 — Utility-first CSS framework. Jaimin uses Tailwind v4's new
  Vite plugin, @theme directive, and custom variant system to build responsive,
  accessible layouts with a consistent design system.

Vite — Fast modern build tool. Jaimin uses Vite for blazing fast HMR during
  development and optimized production builds with intelligent code splitting
  and chunking strategies.

Framer Motion — Production-ready animation library for React. Used for page
  transitions, scroll-based animations, layout animations, and gesture-driven
  interactions (drag, pan, tap).

GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) — Professional animation library. Used for
  complex timeline-based animations, ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven effects,
  and SVG path animations.

Google Gemini API — Google's multimodal large language model. Jaimin uses it
  for AI-powered content generation, blog editing assistance, SEO metadata
  generation, and intelligent admin CMS features.

Node.js + Express — Server-side JavaScript runtime and framework. Jaimin uses
  Express for building REST APIs, implementing SSR for SEO, generating dynamic
  sitemaps, RSS feeds, and llms.txt files.

Supabase — Open-source Firebase alternative built on PostgreSQL. Used for
  projects requiring relational data with real-time subscriptions.

TanStack Query — Powerful asynchronous state management for React. Used for
  data fetching, caching, background refetching, and optimistic UI updates.

# SECTION 7: TECHNICAL EXPERTISE (DETAILED)
================================================================================

FULL STACK DEVELOPMENT
Jaimin builds complete web applications end-to-end. He architects the database
schema, designs the API layer, builds the React frontend, implements auth, sets
up CI/CD, and handles production deployment. His apps are scalable, maintainable,
and built with long-term engineering quality in mind.

REACT EXPERTISE
Jaimin has deep expertise in modern React patterns including functional components,
concurrent features (Suspense, startTransition, useDeferredValue), custom hooks
for reusable logic, and advanced patterns like compound components and render props.
He is comfortable with both CSR, SSR, and hybrid rendering strategies.

NEXT.JS EXPERTISE
Jaimin uses Next.js App Router for SEO-critical applications requiring server-side
rendering. He understands the boundary between Server Components and Client
Components, implements route handlers, uses Next.js Image and Font optimization,
and deploys to Vercel with preview environments.

TYPESCRIPT MASTERY
All of Jaimin's projects use TypeScript in strict mode. He uses advanced TypeScript
features including generics with constraints, conditional types, mapped types,
template literal types, discriminated unions, and declaration merging. He applies
TypeScript to avoid runtime errors and create self-documenting codebases.

FIREBASE ARCHITECTURE
Jaimin has built multiple production applications on Firebase. He understands
Firestore document modeling for NoSQL (flat structures, subcollections, denormalization),
security rules for role-based access, real-time listeners for live data, and Cloud
Functions for server-side logic. He follows Firebase best practices for cost
optimization and performance.

NODE.JS & EXPRESS
Jaimin uses Node.js + Express for custom backend requirements including API
proxying, dynamic sitemap/RSS generation, AI API integration, server-side SEO
metadata injection, and webhook handling.

AI INTEGRATION
Jaimin integrates AI into production applications using the Google Gemini API and
OpenRouter. Use cases include: blog writing assistance with streaming output, SEO
metadata generation, content summarization, code explanation tools, and smart
search. He understands prompt engineering, system prompts, few-shot examples, and
context window management.

SAAS DEVELOPMENT
Jaimin has experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications with user management,
role-based access, subscription tiers, admin dashboards, and usage analytics. He
understands the unique challenges of SaaS architecture including data isolation,
audit logging, and billing integration.

TECHNICAL SEO
Jaimin implements enterprise-grade technical SEO including: JSON-LD structured data
(Person, Article, BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList), canonical URLs, Open Graph
and Twitter Card metadata, dynamic sitemap.xml with blog/project URLs, robots.txt
with AI crawler directives, and the llms.txt standard for AI content discovery.

PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION
Jaimin achieves 90+ Lighthouse scores through: React code splitting with lazy(),
image optimization (WebP, progressive loading, blur-up placeholders), intelligent
bundle chunking (vendor, firebase, editor, charts), immutable caching for hashed
assets, and eliminating render-blocking resources.

SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE
Jaimin applies clean architecture principles: feature-based folder structure,
separation of concerns, service layer abstraction, and reusable hook patterns.
He avoids prop drilling with Context, manages async state with TanStack Query,
and keeps components focused and composable.

API DEVELOPMENT
Jaimin designs RESTful APIs with clear naming conventions, proper HTTP methods,
consistent error responses, pagination, filtering, and rate limiting. He documents
APIs and uses TypeScript for type-safe request/response contracts.

AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY
Jaimin implements Firebase Authentication with email/password, Google OAuth,
and magic link flows. He writes Firestore security rules for role-based access,
sets HTTP security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CSP), and handles JWT token
management with proper expiry and refresh logic.

RESPONSIVE DESIGN & ACCESSIBILITY
Jaimin builds mobile-first responsive layouts using CSS Grid, Flexbox, and
Tailwind CSS breakpoints. He follows WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines: semantic
HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, and sufficient color
contrast ratios.

REACT 19
Version: 19.x (stable)
Jaimin uses React 19 features: use() hook for async resources in render, Server

NEXT.JS 15 APP ROUTER
Version: 15.x
Jaimin uses App Router with parallel routes, intercepting routes, route groups,
Server Components for zero-bundle data fetching, Client Components for
interactivity, and Streaming with Suspense for progressive page rendering.

TAILWIND CSS V4
Version: 4.x
Jaimin uses Tailwind v4's new features: @theme directive for design tokens,
@plugin system, @custom-variant for complex state variants, and the Vite plugin
for optimized CSS processing without PostCSS configuration overhead.

FIREBASE v11
Jaimin uses the modular Firebase SDK (v11) with tree-shaking for minimal bundle
size. Collections: blogs, projects, settings, capabilities, testimonials, messages,
media, faqs, admin. Realtime listener cleanup with onSnapshot unsubscribe patterns.

GOOGLE GEMINI API
Model used: gemini-2.5-flash
Use cases in this portfolio: AI-powered SEO metadata generation in the admin panel,
blog content editing and improvement suggestions, content summarization. Implemented
with streaming support using generateContentStream for real-time UI feedback.

TIPTAP RICH TEXT EDITOR
Version: 3.x
Jaimin uses TipTap as the blog editor in the admin CMS with extensions:
StarterKit, Typography, Link, Image, CodeBlockLowlight (syntax highlighting),
Table, TaskList, TextAlign, Placeholder, BubbleMenu, FloatingMenu, and
CharacterCount. Output is stored as HTML in Firestore.

TANSTACK QUERY
Version: 5.x
Used for all Firestore data fetching in the public-facing app: automatic
caching, background refetching, loading/error states, and paginated queries.
